text:
alex: FYI customer BrightLeaf opened a ticket — they say AWS Marketplace invoice total for 2026-03 doesn't match our usage dashboard (invoice: 12,300 units, our metered tokens: 11,200). they're escalated, want a reconciliation asap.

maria_billing: Can you drop the invoice id + marketplace account id? also which sku/dimension on the invoice?

alex: Invoice ID: INV-2026-03-BL-7432, Marketplace acct: 842-987-334, SKU on invoice: redwood-inference-standard-1 (line items attached by customer).

jamal_eng: quick check — ran our usage query for tenant brightleaf for Mar-01 to Mar-31:
```
SELECT date, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_tokens
WHERE tenant_id = 'brightleaf' AND date >= '2026-03-01' AND date <= '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY date;
```
Result total: 11,200 tokens. exported CSV and S3 path: s3://reconcile-exports/brightleaf/2026-03-usage.csv

sarah_cs: Customer pasted part of the AWS CSV too — their daily totals in AWS report sum to 12,300. They insist we underbilled them.

maria_billing: Two quick theories: 1) AWS Marketplace aggregates by their "billing day" boundary (UTC vs tenant timezone) causing day-of-month bucket differences; 2) Some usage could be attributed to a different marketplace meter (e.g., 'burst' dimension) that we didn't map.

jamal_eng: I compared the two CSVs side-by-side and noticed AWS lines include a handful of records with account_alias = "brightleaf-ops" that map to the same tenant but different account id. Our ingestion pipeline only maps primary_account_id (842-987-334) and ignores alias accounts. 

alex: so AWS is charging combined across alias accounts, while our metering only includes the main account -> explains ~1,100 unit gap. can we confirm?

jamal_eng: Confirmed. Filtering the AWS report for account_alias variations:
```
# preview
account_id, account_alias, sku, units
842-987-334, brightleaf, redwood-inference-standard-1, 10200
843-111-999, brightleaf-ops, redwood-inference-standard-1, 1100
```
When I include both, sum = 11,200 + 1,100 = 12,300.

maria_billing: Good find. We need to backfill those alias account ids into our tenant mapping. I will: a) update tenant mapping table, b) re-run billing ingestion for Mar.

billing-bot: job run queued -> job_id: rb-job-6622. Ingestion window: 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-31.

alex: I'll ping the customer and explain we found an unmapped marketplace account alias and we're rerunning ingestion+recon. asking for patience; ETA ~ 48h.

sarah_cs: Customer replied :thumbsup: they can wait but want the delta line items in a CSV so finance can reconcile with AWS.

jamal_eng: I'll export the reconciled rows once ingestion finishes. Repro steps for ops: 1) add alias in tenant_mapping:
```
INSERT INTO tenant_mapping (tenant_id, marketplace_account_id)
VALUES ('brightleaf', '843-111-999');
```
2) re-run rb-ingest-marketplace --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-31 --force-reprocess --job-id rb-job-6622 3) verify sums match AWS CSV.

maria_billing: Also opened a case with AWS Marketplace support to request canonical account list for BrightLeaf (case AWS-CASE-90433). if there are other aliases we should catch them centrally.

alex: Thanks team. I'll follow up in 48h with the export and updated invoice reconciliation.

maria_billing: Note for postmortem: add a daily alias-sync job to avoid recurring mismatches. created ticket in billing backlog: BILL-281.

sarah_cs: Customer thanked us for quick root cause. closing loop once export sent. :white_check_mark:
